punchline: Chicken Soup for the Soul was turned down by 144 publishers before one agreed to read it.
thirty_sec: Jack Canfield and Mark Victor Hansen put together a collection of short stories and were turned down by 144 publishers, who thought people did not read collections and the title was silly. One finally agreed to read it. Canfield ties this to his Rule of 5: do five specific actions toward the goal every day, and count them.
